<script>
         function onProductClick(id, name, category, href) {
          var item = {
            'id': id,
            'name': name,
            'category': category
          };
          ga('ec:addProduct', item);
          ga('ec:setAction', 'click');
          // Send click with an event, then send user to product page.
          ga('send', 'event', 'UX', 'click', 'Results', {
            hitCallback: function() {
              document.location = href;
            }
          });
        }
    </script>
<script>
        // *******************
        // pro mereni Actions
        // https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/1136920?hl=cs
        // example link(zohlednuje target="_blank" v linku): onclick="trackActionLink(this, 'download', 'pdf', 'urlAdresa', event);return false;"
        // example button: onclick="trackAction('video', 'play', 'videoABC');"
        function trackActionLink(link, category, action, label, e) {
            var win = (link.target == '_blank') ? 1 : 0;
                        //alert('aa');
                ga('send', 'event', category, action, label, { 'hitCallback': hitCallbackHandler(link, win, e) });
                    }

        function trackAction(category, action, label) {
                            ga('send', 'event', category, action, label);
                    }

        function hitCallbackHandler(url, win, e) {
            if (win > 0) {
                if (e != undefined) {
                    window.open(url, win);
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
            } else {
                document.location.href = url;
            }
        }
    </script>

<script>
        function saveSoutez(evt){   
            var email = document.forms["newsletter-validate-detail2"]["newsletterEmail"].value;
            MkTracker.identifyVisitor(email)
           /* var gender = document.forms["newsletter-validate-detail2"]["gender"].value;*/
            var xmlhttp = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xmlhttp.open("POST", "ajax/saveNewsletterEmail.php", true);
            xmlhttp.setRequestHeader('Content-type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded');
            xmlhttp.send("email="+email);
            xmlhttp.onreadystatechange = function() {
                if (this.readyState == 4 && this.status == 200) {
                    if(this.responseText == '{"result":"ok"}'){
                        document.getElementById("modal-body").innerHTML = 'Děkujeme za přihlášení do soutěže.';
                    }
                    else if(this.responseText == '{"result":"allreadyexist"}'){
                        document.getElementById("modal-body").innerHTML = 'Váš email byl již přihlášen do soutěže.';
                    }
                    else{
                        document.getElementById("modal-body").innerHTML = document.getElementById("modal-body").innerHTML + '<br> Omlouváme se, nastala chyba při uložení. Zkuste to prosím za chvíli.'
                    }    
                        
                } 
            };  
            $.cookie("modalShow", 1, { expires: 3650 });  
            evt.preventDefault();
            return false;
        }
        
    </script>

        function addEvent(obj, evt, fn) {
            if (obj.addEventListener) {
                obj.addEventListener(evt, fn, false);
            }
            else if (obj.attachEvent) {
                obj.attachEvent("on" + evt, fn);
            }
        }
        addEvent(window,"load",function(e) {
            addEvent(document, "mouseout", function(e) {
                e = e ? e : window.event;
                var from = e.relatedTarget || e.toElement;
               
                if ((!from || from.nodeName == "HTML") && $.cookie("modalShow") != 1) {
                    // stop your drag event here
                    // for now we can just use an alert
                    $('#myModal').modal('show');
                    $.cookie("modalShow", 1, { expires: 3650 });
                }
            });
        });

                videoJsPath:"modules/revslider/videojs/",
                fullScreenOffsetContainer: ""
            });


            $( ".item_slide" ).click(function() {
                var count = $(this).attr('data-slide');
                revapi.revshowslide(count);
                return false;
            });

            revapi.bind("revolution.slide.onchange",function (e, data) {
                $('.item_slide').removeClass('active');
                $('.item_slide_'+data.slideIndex).addClass('active');
                $('#rev_slider_1_1').find('li').each(function(){
                    if($(this).css('z-index') == 20){
                        $('#sliderRedirect').attr('href',$(this).attr('data-redirect'));
                    }
                })
            });

        });
    </script>
